title: Dream this week - we were singing?
content: I had a dream about being at this mall. Very different setting compared to the usual - it was light inside and crowded this time. I was walking through a wide space, the kind where two halls of stores adjoin, and passed what I think was the high schooler portion. Which is weird because I graduated over a decade ago. I passed by a small group and someone said, “hey, check this out”. He took out a microphone and sang one line of a song and I got second hand embarrassment, thinking he was going to make a scene. Then the whole crowd walking though the area started to join in. Did anyone else have a similar dream? Can you comment or DM me which song it was?
